notes.title: Update notes for v0.4.3
notes.content:
Changes
- Intro's like the boss intro are skippable
- Level 4 gives you more time to read the hint and has a ghost that shows you what to do
- Added a wishlist button on the exit game tab
- Improved pathfinding for the player's ghost you see upon death

Bug fixes
- The player's ghost doesn't show you the correct path when dying on ice
- Side stepping after closing a window / exit the boss
- Notes are sometimes displayed on top of objects

notes.title: Update notes for v2.1
notes.content:
- Added a boss to world 1 (Fungi Forest 10)
- Added frogs to world 1
- Replaced the red arrows with a ghost that shows you where to go
- Made a few improvements to the tutorial based on feedback
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes for v2.0
notes.content:
- Completely reworked all levels to have it start off easy and gradually increase in difficulty
- Levels 1-4 now serve as the tutorial of the game, using both text and visual cues
- Psychedelic mushrooms in some of the forest levels
- Improved all sprites and some of the animations
- New music for every world (temporarily improvement)
- New UI, including main menu, pause menu and tutorial pop-ups
- Assist mode (Available in the options menu)

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2
notes.content:
- Added level 3 and 4 to Forest
- Added a written tutorial as a temporarily solution for the lack of an intro level

notes.title: Update notes for v1.1
notes.content:
- Updated all sprites and animations
- Got rid of the sand tiles in Forest 2
- Changed layout of Forest 2 to fit visual changes
